description: Manual E2E test pass for the Contractor app. Suites in docs/testing/suites/, dated results in docs/testing/runs/. EVERY item is blocked on E2E-000: no contractor account exists and this app's login refuses non-contractors, so the app cannot currently be logged into at all. items.name: fixtures-and-accounts
items.description: BLOCKER for every other item in this module, and it is a backend change (smart-work-permit-api), not a frontend one. Today the database holds ONE account (systemadmin@email.com, role safety_officer) and 2 DRAFT Hot Work permits. POST /auth/user/public/register accepts no `role`, so accounts for the other roles cannot be created through any UI. Produce an idempotent, re-runnable seed seeding fixtures F0-F6 from the master plan (one account per role; one permit per type; one permit in each status; valid + expired certificates; a Confined Space permit with an entrant checked in; a Hot Work permit mid Fire Watch; a stale gas reading), plus a one-command reset. Without the reset a manual pass cannot be repeated: approving and closing permits mutates the fixtures, so tester #2 sees different data from tester #1. File it as an item in the API repo's feature_list.json and link it here.
acceptance: A documented credential table with one working account per role: contractor, safety_officer, inspector
Fixtures F0-F6 exist after `bun run seed`, verified by querying the API, not by reading the seed script
Running the seed twice leaves the same state as running it once (idempotent)
A single documented command resets to the fixture baseline
The corresponding item exists in ../smart-work-permit-api/feature_list.json and is referenced here
items.evidence: DONE 2026-08-19 by the API repo's feat-013 (prisma/seeds/e2e-fixtures.seed.ts, `bun run seed:e2e` / `bun run seed:e2e:reset`). Accounts: contractor@e2e.test / safety@e2e.test / inspector@e2e.test, all password123 (override with E2E_SEED_PASSWORD); systemadmin@email.com untouched. INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED by the orchestrating session, not taken on the agent's word: all three logins return the right role; the contractor sees 10 permits covering all seven statuses and all three types; closing the ACTIVE confined permit answers 403 ENTRANTS_STILL_INSIDE and closing the running-countdown hot permit answers 403 FIRE_WATCH_NOT_ELAPSED. That verification deliberately CLOSED a fixture permit; `bun run seed:e2e:reset` restored the exact baseline and reported the audit chain verified intact across 16 rows — so the reset is proven, not assumed. Not seeded: PermitPhoto rows (need real MinIO objects; the bucket-init container has exited), so the Heights harness-photo evidence slot is empty.

items.name: cross-app-lifecycle-journey
items.description: J1 from the master plan, and the reason E2E testing exists: contractor drafts and submits -> Safety Officer sees it in the queue, reads the backend verdict, approves -> QR issues -> Inspector scans and sees live status -> entrant register runs -> Safety Officer closes -> the audit log shows every step, attributed and in order. Needs BOTH apps running and cannot start until the contractor wizard can submit (PMT-009). This item lives in both repos' registries; run it once, record it in both.
acceptance: The journey is walked end to end in one session, by one tester, with screenshots at each handoff
Each handoff is verified in the OTHER app, not assumed from the first
The audit log at the end contains every state change with the right actor and order
Any step that cannot run is recorded with which item blocks it
